modes.7: increment one target count in the routed 256-bin row
modes.8: full 256-class top-5 plus target natural-log loss

routing: existing guest exact k=4 compact slots (3000); non-exact keys hash their last two bytes into 13384 fallback rows
training: one count increment per training position; no logits or gradients
scope: byte-level context memory; not a word model and not the R27/48M decoder
